bear_assumptions: USD 1.50 normalized forward EPS at 22x; product growth normalizes, foundry losses and investment stay heavy, and execution or competitive setbacks compress the multiple.
base_assumptions: USD 2.50 normalized forward EPS at 32x; product demand remains healthy, yield and utilization improve, and external foundry grows gradually without yet earning mature returns.
bull_assumptions: USD 3.50 normalized forward EPS at 38x; AI compute demand, product share, advanced-node execution and credible external-foundry wins produce substantial operating leverage.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if price offers sufficient margin of safety and scenario returns clear every economic and relationship gate while product growth, process execution, margin recovery, external-foundry demand and cash conversion remain durable; downgrade if competitiveness, process ramps, foundry demand, margins, leverage, dilution, funding, export controls or policy support deteriorate.
